title: Bosses recrafted
description: This project buffs the vanilla bosses (Elder guardian, The Wither and Ender dragon)
body:
This mod buffs vanilla Bosses, such as Elder guardians, the Wither and the Ender dragon by changing some of their stats and abilities.

Here's all the mechanics in the mod:
- Each Elder guardian has now 100HP and a shared boss bar per monument.
- Elder guardians now have a dash ability where it crashes into the target and breaks all blocks in the way.
- Elder guardians now can calls Guardians for defense every time their HP reaches 75%, 50% or 25%.
- If the Wither misses 3 shots then it's gonna summon 4 Wither skeletons around the missed target.
- The Wither can also dash, but digs deeper and makes the target jump high in the air.
- The Ender dragon now has a dig attack, where she simply rushes at high speed towards the closest player and digs underground until it reaches the void, launching the target far away into the air.
